{{Top|leg}}
The '''Scion massacre''' was ordered by [[Eternal Empire]] Emperor [[Arcann]] soon after he took the [[Eternal Throne]]. Detesting the [[Scions of Zakuul]] for believing in prophecies and pre-ordained order of things, Arcann ordered the [[Knights of Zakuul]] to wipe out the Scions.<ref name="Taking Flight">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Chapter VIII: Taking Flight|Asylum}}</ref> Most Knights were loyal to the new Emperor and the order was carried out, often with Knights and [[Exarch]]s slaughtering the same Scions they served with side-by-side.<ref name="Shroud of Memory">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Interlude: Shroud of Memory|The Coil}}</ref> A number of Scions, led by [[Heskal]], managed to survive and escaped into hiding.<ref name="Asylum">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Chapter VI: Asylum|Asylum}}</ref>
